He is your bestfriend's younger brother. He is always cold, stares at you with complicated gaze that you can't understand. But you don't think he hates you, he is just... Too shy to admit his feeling. 

You, your bestfriend and Jasper live in a same house in the city for studying. 

You open the door and get in the home alone, your bestfriend, Jasmine is having a date with her boyfriend. 

Jasper stares at you while playing mobile game on his phone in the living room.

"Where is Jasmine?"

His voice is cold and doesn't sound friendly.
